summary: The root هزل (hazala) means to jest, joke, or not be serious. It's the opposite of being earnest. It can refer to speech or an affair.
lane: 1 هَزْلٌ ذ is contr. of جِدٌّ . (S, Mgh, K.) You say, هَزَلَ , aor. هَزِلَ , inf. n. هَزْلٌ ; (S, Msb, K;) and هَزِلَ , aor. هَزَلَ , (K,) inf. n. as above; (TA;) and ; (K;) He jested, or joked; (Msb;) or was not serious, or in earnest; (TA;) فِى كَلاَمِهِ in his speech; (Msb, TA;) and فِى الأَمْرِ in the affair. (TA.)
